# Upstream notices

These files are copied verbatim from the versions in `components.lock.json`.
`provenance.json` records their source URLs and hashes. containerd, kubelet and
crictl retain their upstream licensing; Dragonfly's license is extracted from its
hash-verified release archive. Ubuntu package copyright notices are retained by
mkosi even with documentation disabled, alongside applicable common licenses.

This is an initial notice inventory, not a complete dependency/license audit.
Before a public binary release, review transitive Go/Rust dependencies, firmware,
redistribution conditions and corresponding-source availability for exact package
versions. Archive or mirror required source alongside supported binaries; upstream
links alone do not establish that the distributor fulfilled its obligations.
